The CAM-0402-NDI-BRG is a compact and powerful 4K multi-camera video bridge designed to simplify video switching and integration for conferencing, streaming, recording, and hybrid events. Supporting up to four wired inputs (2x HDMI, 2x USB) and four network-based NDI streams, this device delivers a unified video output via USB, HDMI, or NDI — all in stunning 4K resolution.

Seamlessly mix up to eight video sources from a variety of formats — including 2 HDMI inputs, 2 USB 3.0 UVC cameras, and 4 NDI streams over the network. This versatility allows users to combine local and remote sources in a single workflow, making it ideal for hybrid meetings, training sessions, and multi-angle streaming productions.

The CAM-0402-NDI-BRG delivers a unified video output through USB (UVC) & HDMI simultaneously. Whether you need a clean single view or a multiview layout with up to four sources on-screen at once, this device offers maximum flexibility for streaming, local display, and remote contribution — all in up to 4K resolution.

The CAM-0402-NDI-BRG delivers a unified video output through USB (UVC), HDMI, and NDI simultaneously. The USB HOST output appears as a standard UVC/UAC webcam, making it instantly recognized by any video conferencing or recording platform without additional drivers.
